versions.spid3r:
spid3r 1.0.0 (language 1.0)
Rust host, no runtime dependencies.

benchmarks.name: Arithmetic & Loop
benchmarks.desc: Tight loop of 2M iterations accumulating integer additions (tests loop & ALU throughput)

benchmarks.name: List Churn
benchmarks.desc: Push 100K elements to dynamic array then pop all elements summing their values

benchmarks.name: Map / Dict Operations
benchmarks.desc: Insert 20K key-value pairs into a hash table and look up all keys

benchmarks.name: String Concatenation
benchmarks.desc: Sequential concatenation building a 30,000-character string in a loop

benchmarks.name: Closure Creation & Calls
benchmarks.desc: Create and invoke 20,000 heap-allocated closures capturing lexical environments

benchmarks.name: Class Method Dispatch
benchmarks.desc: Instantiate an object and invoke an incrementing instance method 200,000 times

benchmarks.name: JSON Parse & Stringify
benchmarks.desc: Serialize 2,000 structured nested maps/lists to JSON strings and parse them back

benchmarks.name: Concurrency / Channels
benchmarks.desc: Producer-consumer message passing across tasks/threads transmitting 2,000 messages
